newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus eight barges on Thursday.
- Two barges, Osceola to Cairo, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, no bid, offer 110 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 112-1/2 percent, unchanged from Thursday, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, no bid, offer 150 percent, unchanged from Thursday, similar.
- Two barges, Memphis, Mississippi River, $500 switch, next week, no bid, offer 150 percent, no comparison.
